The attached data is the raw data on the pesticides measured in aquatic ecosystems across Ontario from 2002 to 2016 reported by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC). These data were extracted from Environment and Climate Change Canada National Long-term Water Quality Monitoring Data dataset.
